source.literature_2026: Pozsgai et al. (2026) Scientific Reports 16:27703 doi:10.1038/s41598-026-57146-5

original_published_design.extra_or_nonpristine_island: Graciosa may appear among broader source records but is NOT in original seven-island repeatedly sampled native core, never silently assimilate
original_published_design.core_repeated_transects_discrepancy: Authors report 30 repeated sites in one section, 31 transects in published source paper; determine exact author site/period supports BEFORE any Occurrence read
original_published_design.original_nesting: island > native forest fragment > 150m transect > 3 temporal BALA phases > ground pitfall or native-tree beating > individual Event traps/samples. Never treat 10379 Event rows or 63904 Occurrences as independent physical sites
original_published_design.prior_art_ceiling: 2026 original authors already found aggregate abundance/biomass/richness largely stable and species-specific increases/declines; these are prior work, not a new Structural discovery. Independent target must be community-composition turnover/replacement within same sites and guilds, compared across multiple islands.

new_scientific_question: Does taxonomic community composition undergo different degrees of within-site species replacement among spiders vs beetles and endemic vs introduced arthropods over the three BALA survey campaigns, even where richness/abundance appears stable? Is the direction of compositional reorganization consistent across multiple Azorean islands and source forest fragments?
data_gate_sequence: v1.310 original exact archive zip central directory and meta.xml ONLY; no Event/Occurrence data values. Freeze original zip SHA and identify necessary field terms.
v1.311 source-Event-only physical transect/year/method design check, using original SHA. Freeze site-year campaign joins and effort before reading taxon names.

v1.312 one-shot original species occurrence read only AFTER the original Event physical gate qualifies and the prespecified primary statistic, origin ontology, pairing, denominators and quality floors are frozen.

candidate_primary.unit: Source-matched forest transect, not each trap or beating Event. Each transect×campaign observed taxon set by same method class (ground vs canopy) and taxonomic guild.
candidate_primary.effect: For each source-matched transect and guild, compare B1 and B3 species sets using Jaccard or Sørensen decomposition into replacement vs richness-difference components. Report whether high turnover can coexist with modest net richness change. Native/endemic/introduced origin status only when exact source metadata proves status field and values are reliable.
candidate_primary.comparison: Spiders versus beetles paired within exact same original transect, source method, phases; summarize per original island and fragment with actual author site n. Do not interpret 45 pairwise observations as independent and do not infer local extinction/colonization from nondetection.
candidate_primary.zero_data_policy: If core transect ID is missing, sampling methods are noncomparable or source origin fields undocumented, STOP or report a restricted, separately frozen design BEFORE taxon access, not an artificially positive result.
